title: Winkel tripel (synthetic test template)
description: Synthetic test template for the test suite, not a map of the Earth: the Winkel tripel outline and stud locations from the numpy forward formula and a Newton inverse, land from a fixed rule on the locations instead of ETOPO 2022.

projection.name: winkel-tripel
projection.citation: Winkel, O. (1921), Neue Gradnetzkombinationen, Petermanns Geographische Mitteilungen 67; Snyder, J. P. (1993), Flattening the Earth: Two Thousand Years of Map Projections, University of Chicago Press, pp. 231-232; PROJ, Winkel Tripel (wintri), https://proj.org/en/stable/operations/projections/wintri.html

dataset.citation: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information. 2022: ETOPO 2022 15 Arc-Second Global Relief Model. NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information.
dataset.license: Public domain (U.S. Government work, NOAA NCEI)

method.land_rule: synthetic: south of 66 S, or within 72 degrees of the equator where sin(2 lon + 40) cos(1.5 lat) > 0.45 (not ETOPO; the dataset entry only gives the file its contract shape)
method.location_rule: inverse of the stud centre (Newton on the numpy forward formula); spherical mean of the on-globe subsamples when the centre lies outside the outline
